name: Briarwood
blurb: Briar can end a run now. Reach the burrow.
notes: 1-3 · Briarwood. Teach: some things hurt. About 90 seconds. Make the first death cheap: respawn is instant (a 0.4s burst of fluff), with no fail screen and no counter. Map: 1720px = 9,600pt (x scale 5.58).

rects.note: Beat 01: a briar bed under a mossy shelf, in view but out of reach.
Beat 05: the hollow log from 1-1 returns, with thorns on its roof.

briars.note: Beat 02: one low tuft with plenty of clearance.
Beat 03: the thorn seed floats one Puff-width above this tuft.
Beat 09: the slalom. Thorns alternate floor and roof; where neighbours overlap, the vertical gap between their tips is the level gap. Every cluster ends two screens before the burrow.
